subject: [PATCH v9 21/32] mm: free PMD swap entries in zap_huge_pmd()

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch modifies the zap_huge_pmd() function to handle PMD swap entries before attempting to access a folio, preventing potential memory leaks and warnings. It checks if the PMD is a swap entry, and if so, it frees the associated swap slots and updates the memory management counters accordingly.
